purpose: Baseline measurement for rotation-signal integrity; not a threshold calibration result.

kiwa-20260712-clear-air-sequence.interpretation: The raw detector remains intentionally sensitive, but no clear-air candidate was promoted by cell-footprint and vertical-evidence assessment.

ktlx-20130520-newcastle-moore-tornado.interpretation: The confirmed tornado context retains cell-associated, vertically confirmed evidence; this is not a tornado-probability or warning claim.

ktlx-20130520-moore-large-hail.interpretation: The non-tornado severe context retains cell-associated, vertically confirmed evidence; this prevents treating the product as a tornado classifier.

limitations: The KIWA sequence was replayed through the tracker and produced zero persistent assessments; the two severe contexts are single-volume cases and therefore cannot establish persistence.
Case labels describe documented event context, not per-gate truth labels.
No numerical detection threshold was selected from this result.
